name: Rocket Stick Minis - Injected Pre Roll Pack (5 x 0.6g) - Grape Soda
description:
Big flavor, mini size. The Rocket Stick Minis Grape Soda pack gives you five 0.6-gram infused pre-rolls — 3 grams total — each packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. Perfectly portioned for shorter sessions, sharing with friends, or keeping a few on hand.

Grape Soda pours on that fizzy soda-fountain flavor: sweet purple grape up front with a bright, bubbly snap and a smooth, candy-sweet finish. It's a fun, taste-forward crowd-pleaser built for easy, flavorful sessions with an extra step up in strength.

Why you'll love it:

5 × 0.6G infused minis — 3G total, quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes
Perfectly portioned — right-sized for a quick session or passing around
Bold Grape Soda flavor — sweet purple grape with a fizzy, candy-sweet finish
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every mini. Rocket Stick Minis Grape Soda is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
